question: Which Indian sporting award is given for outstanding performance in sports coaching?

options.text: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dronacharya Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is India's highest honor for outstanding contributions in sports coaching.
 
• It was instituted by the Government of India in **1985** to recognize and honor coaches who help athletes achieve excellence in international sports.
 
• The award is named after the legendary mentor **Dronacharya** from the Indian epic Mahabharata, symbolizing exceptional coaching skills.
 
• Recipients of the award receive a **.
 
• It is conferred annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports under the National Sports Awards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**: This is India's highest sporting honor for outstanding performance in sports and games.
 
• **Arjuna Award**: Instituted in 1961, this award recognizes exceptional achievements in sports disciplines.
 
• **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**: Introduced in 2009, this award acknowledges entities that contribute to sports promotion and development.
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is distinct from athlete-centric awards as it specifically honors the efforts of coaches in shaping sporting talent.
 
• Over the years, recipients of the Dronacharya Award have played a crucial role in India's success at international sporting events such as the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.
